selection: Rank eligible candidates by baseline-cost cumulative summer-only portfolio return minus persistent fallback over 2021-2023. Exact ties prefer fewer changes: baseline, no-summer-fade, ung-price, combined. Lock rank winner before calculating 2024 or holdout metrics. Accept research nomination only if train edge > 0, validation2024 edge > 0 and >=20 gas-active validation sessions. No replacement if validation fails. Elevated/stress, all-year-long-only, 2025+ and outage are report-only. Summer-only portfolios use fallback on every winter session; all-year portfolios retain original winter targets except explicitly diagnostic all-year-long-only.
unchanged: Existing anomaly/confidence/breadth thresholds, sizing, freshness, follow duration, storage-release timing, and costs; no parameter grid or hindsight tuning. No broker submission or production strategy change.
limitations: Historical summer calendars use legacy hours-0, unlike corrected four-sample current live weather. Results diagnose changes on old inputs, not exact current deployed input contract.
Winter remains fitted on original train<=2024-03-31, validation<=2025-10-31. All-year2025 is not fully held out even though summer2025 is excluded from this selection.
Existing2021-2026 data already observed in prior development; held out from this fitting only, not pristine.
